vfx.item_glow.label: weapons and tools: glows, flames and embers on the item

vfx.destruction.label: destruction debris of pieces, props and rocks

vfx.magic.label: magic and boss attacks: staffs, charges, beams, breath, lightning

vfx.hit_material.label: impacts on things and projectile hits: sparks, chips, mud

vfx.tree.label: tree chopping, falling logs and sawdust

vfx.weather.label: weather: rain, snow, ash, wind, fog around the player

vfx.water.label: water and lava splashes, wakes and surface rings

vfx.ambient.label: ambient: fireflies, flies, mist, bubbling pools, heat haze

vfx.fire_fuel.label: fire flare-ups when fuel is added

vfx.aura.label: auras and glows on creatures and things

pixel.label: pixel bits: tiny flat-colour squares (8 px or untextured)

smoke.label: smoke and dust clouds: big soft lit puffs, alpha-blended

flame.label: flames: a flipbook or soft blob, additive or gradient-mapped, rising slowly

debris.label: mesh debris: chunks, splinters, drops rendered as small meshes

blood.label: blood: drops, splats and mist in dark red

glow.label: glows and flares: one or a few big soft additive or alpha sprites

slime.label: slime, mud, sap, tar and lava: thick splashes and blobs

trail.label: trails: ribbons behind particles or moving objects

sparkle.label: twinkles: star-shaped glints that pop and fade in place (dropped items, pickups)

decal.label: decals: splats projected on the ground

ember.label: embers and cinders: small additive points drifting up for seconds

spark.label: sparks: tiny bright additive points or streaks, fast, often falling

carrier.label: no material: a parent that only carries sub-emitters, lights or sound

ring.label: rings and shockwaves: flat or billboard rings growing outwards

leaves.label: leaves, needles, feathers, hair: small textured flakes tumbling down

light.label: light carriers: systems whose particles drive lights

flash.label: flashes: a big bright sprite for a fraction of a second at the start
